# Remove Latin accents

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/remove-accents/

Remove common combining accents from Latin text while keeping the rest of the text intact. Copy a simplified form for matching or legacy systems.

## How to use it

1. Type or paste the text you want to work with.
2. Choose a conversion, clean-up or output option.
3. Copy the result or download it when an export is available.

## Example

Convert café and résumé into cafe and resume for a simple search index.

## Limits and checks

Removing accents can change names or meaning. This is not a transliteration system for Nepali or other writing systems.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
